# `artifacts/`

**Owner (only this person pushes here):** **generated by scripts** (Sanchita commits the final model)

Saved models + metadata. Don't commit files over 100 MB.

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `final_model.joblib` | tuned model used by the API |
| `model_meta.json` | feature columns, params, seed |
| `<name>.joblib` | per-experiment models (written by the harness) |
